new_result.statement: If G~N(0,Sigma), Sigma>=sigma^2 I, and symmetric A has at least three eigenvalues with absolute value>=1, then G^T A G has a bounded continuous density with supnorm <=1/(2 sqrt(2) sigma^2). The bound is sharp for rank-three signature (2,1) with Sigma=sigma^2 I. Since every cap-one density has variance >=1/12, every centered matching-Gaussian surrogate obeys the sharp ceiling 3 sqrt(2).

partner_result_applied.application: Partner's exact rotated cap-one bank witness satisfies p_Qm(0)=3sqrt(2)(1-5295/(21952m)+O(m^-2)); its isotropic Gaussian limit saturates the new centered-Gaussian ceiling exactly.
